newsitem.title: USA: MCI starts Los Angeles, San Diego local service.
newsitem.headline: MCI starts Los Angeles, San Diego local service.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said Monday it has launched competitive local telephone service in Los Angeles and San Diego.
MCI said in a statement the move makes it the first of the major U.S. long distance carriers to "aggressively seek a significant share of California's $10.5 billion local telephone market."

"Thanks to the inauguration of our new local networks in Los Angeles and San Diego, even more (Pacific Telesis Group's) Pacific Bell customers now have a real choice for local service," said Lynn Coker, MCI's director of local service.
MCI's entry in the local service arena began more than two years ago when MCI began to develop and construct its own local switched networks across the country.
The company offers local service in 16 major markets throughout the country. By early next year, San Francisco will be added.
